edit.description: the reach the scan folds to a fixed point, which keeps the names and drops the declarations that armed them

summary: a budget finding names the declaration — file and line — that made a name reach a spawn or a timer, so a collision with an unrelated name of the same spelling is read rather than re-derived

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: every finding the lane's budget and ceiling verdicts render carries, beside the name, the declaration that made that name reach a spawn or a wall-clock timer; the name-wide reach stays the declared over-approximation and the site states that it is, so a reader of a collision stops re-deriving which declaration armed it
tests: a budget finding names the declaration that armed its reaching name
pins: a name declared twice in one module reaches when either declaration does
notes: Operator ruling, option 2 of the scopeless-name-reach question: the over-approximation stays the trade and the finding names the arming declaration so a fifth note reads the answer at the site. The fold returns bare names today; the walk it reads already holds every declaration node per name, so the site is in hand. The scan has no scopes by design — an under-approximation is the one direction it must not take.
